blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for general-purpose robot control, yet a vast majority of policies do not preserve and leverage episode-level information beyond current observation. This limitation is consequential in history-dependent manipulation tasks that depend on information available only in past observations. Retaining past observations in context can aid in recovering this information, but at the significant cost of ever-growing bloated context and inference latency. We thus introduce MemBodied , a fixed-size episodic memory with two complementary components: an associative state that records interactions across policy calls and an episode anchor that preserves a compact representation of the initial scene as a reference. At each policy call, the model conditions action generation on the current input and the memory components, rather than directly using past observations. Across five evaluated RMBench tasks requiring memory, MemBodied achieves 7.81 × 7.81\times the mean success rate of a stateless policy and 2.98 × 2.98\times of vanilla recurrent memory, while outperforming the strongest memory-augmented baseline by 1.3 × 1.3\times with 10 × 10\times fewer added parameters. On the fully observable LIBERO-Long suite, it reached 90.6%, a 5.4% improvement over the stateless π 0 \pi_{0} policy. These findings support MemBodied as a practical alternative to expanding the policy context for history-dependent manipulation.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言-行动模型为通用机器人控制提供了坚实基础,然而绝大多数政策并没有保存和利用超出当前观察的插曲级信息. 这种限制是依赖历史的操纵任务的结果,这些任务仅依赖于过去观测中掌握的信息。 保留以往的观察可以帮助恢复这些资料,但代价高昂的是不断膨胀的背景和推论延迟。 因此,我们介绍了MemBodied,一种固定大小的零星记忆,它有两个互补的组成部分:一种是记录政策呼吁之间相互作用的关联状态,一种是作为参考保留最初场景的紧凑表述的插播主播。 在每次政策呼吁中,模型都会为当前输入和内存组件的动作生成提供条件,而不是直接使用过去的观察. MemBodied在评估的五项需要记忆的人民币任务中,实现了7.81×7.81\的无国籍政策平均成功率和2.98×2.98×的香草重复记忆率,同时在1.3×1.3×1.3×次的基础上,完成了最强的记忆增强基线,增加了10×10×次参数。 在完全可见的LIBERO-Long套房中,该套房达到了90.6%,比无国籍者政策改善5.4%。 这些调查结果支持MemBodied作为扩大依赖历史操纵的政策环境的切实替代办法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are increasingly a mainstay for general robot control as they map semantic representations learned from large vision-language datasets to continuous or token-based actions. RT-2 and OpenVLA formulate actions within vision-language backbones Brohan et al. (2023) ; Kim et al. (2025b) ; Octo Team et al. (2024) learns a diffusion-based generalist policy from heterogeneous robot data; and π 0 \pi_{0} couples a pretrained vision-language model to a continuous flow-matching action expert ( Black et al., 2024 ) . More recent models, such as OpenVLA-OFT Kim et al. (2025a) and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} Intelligence et al. (2025) , have improved control efficiency, action generation, and open-world generalisation. Together, these developments have made VLA policies increasingly capable at complex manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言-动作(VLA)模型越来越成为一般机器人控制的支柱,因为它们将从大型视觉语言数据集学到的语义表达方式映射为连续或以符号为基础的动作. RT-2和OpenVLA在视觉语言主干范围内制定行动,Brohan等人(2023年);Kim等人(2025年b年);Octo Team等人(2024年)从不同的机器人数据中学习了基于传播的通论政策;和 π0\pi_{0}夫妇预先训练的视觉语言模型到连续流匹配动作专家(Black等人,2024年). 较近期的模型,如OpenVLA-OFT Kim et al. (2025a) 和 ^ 0.5\pi0.5} Intelligence et al. (2025),提高了控制效率,行动生成,以及开放世界的普及. 这些事态发展加在一起,使得志愿军政策越来越能够执行复杂的操纵任务。

blocks.en: However, many existing VLA policies condition each policy call on the current observation and the language instruction to predict future action chunks. These approaches discard past information, limiting the policy’s ability to complete memory-dependent manipulation tasks. Although action chunking promotes consistency within a predicted horizon, it does not preserve observational information across subsequent policy calls. For example, if a robot moves an object away from its initial position and must later return the object, the current observation may no longer reveal the correct destination. This is a temporal state aliasing problem, where identical or similar current observations may require different actions depending on the past observations.
blocks.zh: 然而,许多现有的志愿军和志愿军政策都要求每项政策采用目前的意见和语言指示来预测今后的行动。 这些方法抛弃了过去的信息,限制了政策完成依赖内存的操纵任务的能力. 虽然将行动分割开来有助于预测范围内的一致性,但它并没有保存后续政策呼吁的观察信息。 例如,如果一个机器人将一个物体从其初始位置移走,并且必须稍后返回该物体,当前观察可能不再揭示正确的目的地. 这是一个时间状态别名问题,当前相同或相似的观测可能根据以往观测结果需要不同的行动.

blocks.en: Although preserving history is desirable, placing past observations directly into the policy context is costly. Retaining the complete history causes the context length, memory consumption, and inference cost to grow throughout an episode. A fixed observation window bounds these costs but may discard task-relevant evidence once it falls outside the window. Moreover, the relevant evidence may be a short event separated from the current decision by many intermediate observations. An effective memory must therefore preserve relevant information without growing in size or inference cost over the episode.
blocks.zh: 虽然保存历史是可取的,但将过去的意见直接纳入政策背景代价高昂。 保留完整的历史会导致背景长度,记忆消耗,推论成本在整个剧集中不断增长. 一个固定的观察窗口会约束这些费用,但一旦与任务有关的证据落到窗口之外,可能会丢弃。 此外,由于许多中间意见,相关证据可能与当前决定相分离的短暂事件。 因此,有效的记忆必须保存相关信息,而不会因剧集而增加规模或推论成本。

blocks.en: Recent work addresses this problem by compressing historical observations Koo et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2026) , maintaining recurrent latent representations Cherepanov et al. (2026b) ; Li et al. (2026) ; Guo et al. (2026) , or explicitly storing and retrieving historical information Fang et al. (2025) ; Shi et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2025) ; Haresh et al. (2026) . Methods that retain compressed observations as history tokens can still enlarge the policy context as new information is added. Recurrent-token methods keep the recurrent state fixed in size, but rely on carried embeddings to implicitly preserve and expose relevant information through repeated transformations. Memory-bank, retrieval, and language-based approaches may instead introduce auxiliary objectives or additional processing pipelines. These considerations motivate a memory that is updated online, remains fixed in size, and retrieves information according to the policy’s current state. Associative memory meets these requirements through an explicit read/write structure in which the delta rule specifies how the state is updated while the policy learns what to write, retain, and retrieve using only its action objective.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作通过压缩历史观察来解决这一问题. Koo等人(2026年); Wang et al. (2026),保持经常性的潜在表述Cherepanov等人(2026b),Li等人(2026),Guo等人(2026),或明确存储和检索历史资料Fang等人(2025),Shi等人(2026),Li等人(2025),Haresh等人(2026). 保留压缩观测数据作为历史标志的方法,随着新信息的加入,仍然可以扩大政策背景。 经常调试方法保持经常状态的大小固定,但依靠挂载嵌入来通过反复转换来隐含保存和曝光相关信息. 记忆库、检索和基于语言的方法可能引入辅助目标或额外的加工管道。 这些考虑激发了一种在线更新的内存,保持固定的大小,并根据政策的现状检索信息。 关联内存通过明确的读写结构满足这些要求,其中三角洲规则具体规定了状态的更新方式,而政策则仅使用其行动目标来学习写作,保留和检索什么.

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce MemBodied , an episodic memory for VLA control designed to preserve both interaction history and initial-scene information. Its associative memory stores interactions in layer-wise matrices through learned read and write interfaces. After each policy call, the model combines the executed action with its observed visual consequence and writes this interaction using a gated delta update. Because repeated updates may overwrite fine-grained details from early in the episode, the anchor pathway provides persistent access to a compact representation of the initial scene. At subsequent calls, information retrieved from both memory mechanisms conditions the action network. This division of roles allows past interactions and initial-scene evidence to inform action prediction while keeping the memory footprint and access cost independent of episode length.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了MemBodied, 一种用于VLA控制(英语:VLA control)的偶联记忆,旨在保存交互历史和初始场景信息. 它的关联内存通过学习的读写接口,在层层矩阵中存储相互作用. 在每个政策呼吁之后,模型将被执行的动作与其所观察到的视觉后果结合起来,并使用一个有门的三角洲更新来写作这个交互. 由于反复更新可能会覆盖剧集早期的精细细节,主播路径提供持续访问初始场景的紧凑表现. 在随后的呼声中,从两个内存机制中检索到的信息为动作网络提供了条件. 这种角色划分允许过去的相互作用和初始场景证据为动作预测提供参考,同时保持记忆足迹和访问成本独立于剧集长度.

blocks.en: We address three research questions in this paper: RQ1: How effective is MemBodied for memory-dependent manipulation compared with existing approaches? RQ2: How computationally efficient is MemBodied during inference? RQ3: Does MemBodied preserve performance on fully observable or Markovian manipulation where memory is not required?
blocks.zh: 我们在本文中谈到三个研究问题: RQ1:与现有方法相比,MemBodied对依赖内存的操纵有多有效? RQ2:在推论中MemBodied的计算效率如何? RQ3:MemBodied是否在完全可观察的或者不需要内存的马尔科维安操纵上保存性能?

blocks.en: Across five memory-dependent RMBench tasks, MemBodied achieves 7.81 × 7.81\times the mean success rate of a stateless π 0 \pi_{0} policy and 2.98 × 2.98\times that of vanilla recurrent memory, outperforming NativeMEM’s compressed-history approach by 1.30 × 1.30\times . Evaluated on a second VLA backbone ( π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ), MemBodied yields a 3.87 × 3.87\times performance increase over the stateless policy. On physical robot experiments across three tasks, MemBodied demonstrates an 8.0 × 8.0\times improvement in success rate. Crucially, MemBodied achieves these gains while reducing inference latency by 91.9 % 91.9\% relative to NativeMEM. On LIBERO, MemBodied achieved 95.1% mean success rate, comparable to π 0 \pi_{0} ’s result of 94.2%. Notably, on the long-horizon LIBERO-Long suite, MemBodied reached 90.6%, exceeding the π 0 \pi_{0} result of 85.2% by 5.4 percentage points. These results demonstrate that MemBodied improves history-dependent control while remaining competitive on fully observable manipulation tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: HAMLET Koo et al. (2026) and NativeMEM Wang et al. (2026) compress observations into historical tokens. μ \mu VLA Cherepanov et al. (2026b) , ReMem-VLA Li et al. (2026) , and AVA-VLA Xiao et al. (2026) carry recurrent latent states across control steps. SAM2Act Fang et al. (2025) , MemoryVLA Shi et al. (2026) , MAP-VLA Li et al. (2025) , and Notes-to-Self Haresh et al. (2026) use memory banks, retrieval, or language-based records. These approaches trade off explicit access to past evidence against the cost of retaining history or introducing additional memory components. MemBodied instead represents episode history through an evolving associative state and an initial-scene anchor, whose readouts condition the action expert. It therefore neither appends a growing sequence of observations nor retrieves discrete past observations. We discuss these and other related work in more detail in Appendix A .

blocks.en: This delayed-write schedule allows the stored value to include the observed consequence of an action without exposing that future observation to the action that caused it. During inference, the policy caches the preceding layer states and the sampled action chunk from the final denoising step, and performs the write when the next observation arrives. Thus, training and inference use the same causal interpretation of an interaction event.

blocks.en: 3.6 Sequence training
blocks.zh: 3.6 序列培训

blocks.en: The delayed write makes sequence-level training necessary. An action loss at a later policy call must propagate through memory operations performed at earlier calls to train the memory parameters. Each training sample comprises a sequence of N N observation-action pairs. Consecutive pairs are separated by one action horizon of H H environment steps, approximating successive policy calls during execution. Image encoding and policy-input construction are parallelised across the batch and sequence dimensions, while the memory state is propagated sequentially through the sequence. Gradients pass through the full sequence, allowing later action losses to optimise earlier memory operations. The memory parameters are thus learned jointly through the policy’s native action objective, without a separate memory-prediction loss.
blocks.zh: 延迟的写作使得序列级训练成为必要. 在后来的政策呼吁中,行动损失必须通过在较早的呼吁中执行的内存操作来传播,以训练内存参数. 每个培训样本包括N观测-行动对的序列。 连续的对子被H环境步骤的一个动作视野分隔开来,近似执行过程中接连的政策呼声. 图像编码和政策投入构建在批量和序列维度上平行,而内存状态则通过序列相继传播. 渐变通过整个序列,使得后来的动作损失可以优化早期的内存操作. 因此,记忆参数是通过政策的本土行动目标共同学习的,没有单独的记忆预测损失。

blocks.en: RMBench Chen et al. (2026) is a bimanual simulation benchmark that organises tasks by memory complexity. Its M ⁡ ( 1 ) M(1) -category of tasks require retention of task-relevant observations from a single past event, whereas the M ⁡ ( n ) M(n) tasks require information from multiple past events. Our five-task evaluation covered three M ⁡ ( 1 ) M(1) tasks: put_back_block , rearrange_blocks , and swap_blocks ; and two M ⁡ ( n ) M(n) tasks: battery_try and block_ranking_try . We conducted 50 rollouts per task and report each task’s success rate and the mean across the five tasks.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2(b) , MemBodied achieves 91.9% lower inference latency while using 9.5% less peak GPU memory, as compared to NativeMEM. MemBodied also introduces substantially fewer 40M parameters (only 1.26% of π 0 \pi_{0} ), roughly one-tenth of NativeMEM’s 415M (12.81% of π 0 \pi_{0} ). During inference, NativeMEM encodes the incoming observations with its video-history encoder and adds the resulting tokens to the VLA context, introducing an additional encoding step and a growing context size. In contrast, MemBodied maintains a fixed-size recurrent state that is read during action generation and updated at the start of a new policy call. Together, these results show that MemBodied achieves higher mean success than NativeMEM with substantially lower inference latency, parameter overhead, and memory footprint.

blocks.en: Figures 4(a) and 1 compare the associative-state variants and the contribution of the episode anchor pathway. Among the anchor-free variants, memory-token injection reaches 37.6% mean success, compared with 23.2% for hierarchical memory and 20.8% for attention steering. This indicates that feeding the retrieved vector as contextual content is more effective, in our setting, than the two alternative memory designs. The combined two-pathway memory reaches 50.0%, compared with 37.6% when the anchor pathway is removed. Relative to the anchor-free variant, the MemBodied improves on four out of five tasks, with the largest gain on Swap Blocks, from 16.0% to 56.0%. However, the anchor reduces performance on Block Ranking from 32.0% to 22.0%; this task depends more on tracking evolving task progress than recalling the initial scene, making the fixed first-frame reference potentially less useful. Overall, both the memory-token design and episode anchor contribute to the complete memory formulation, although the anchor’s effect is task-dependent.

On Put Back Block and Rearrange Blocks, visual information accounts for most of the measured performance, with the action summary adding 2 and 4 percentage points. On Battery Try, the combined value reaches 30.0%, compared with 24.0% for vision alone and 22.0% for action alone; removing either modality therefore reduces success by 6 or 8 points. blocks.en: Manual annotation of 50 seed-matched rollout pairs per task shows that MemBodied and π 0 \pi_{0} -Stateless behave similarly when the current observation is sufficient, but diverge at decisions requiring past information. For example, on Put Back Block, MemBodied reduces wrong-pad returns from 37/50 to 13/50, although both policies complete the preceding block movement and button press in every rollout (see more details in Appendix E ). Across tasks, MemBodied more often selects the episode-specific target, tracks task progress, and uses earlier outcomes to guide subsequent attempts. Its remaining failures largely involve motor execution or longer-term tracking. These observations localise MemBodied ’s gains to decisions that require information no longer visible in the current observation.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced MemBodied , a fixed-capacity episodic memory that combines an associative memory state with an initial-scene anchor without expanding the policy context. Across five memory-dependent RMBench tasks, it achieved 50.0% mean success, outperforming stateless, frame-history, vanilla recurrent, and compressed-history baselines. The improvements also extended to the π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} backbone and three real-robot tasks. Importantly, the gains in memory-dependent manipulation do not come at the expense of inference efficiency. Compared with NativeMEM, MemBodied pairs higher mean success with substantially lower latency and memory footprint. MemBodied also preserves general manipulation ability, maintaining comparable mean success on LIBERO while improving on the long-horizon suite. Together, these results support MemBodied as a practical alternative to expanding observation histories in VLA control.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了MemBodied,一种固定容量的瞬间记忆,它结合了一个关联记忆状态和一个初始-场景主锚,而不扩展政策背景. 在五个依赖记忆的人民币任务中,它取得了50.0%的成功,超过了无国籍者、帧历史、香草重复和压缩历史基线。 改进范围也扩大到了 0.5\pi\\0.5}骨干和三个真正的机器人任务。 重要的是,依赖记忆的操纵带来的收益不会损害推断效率。 与本土MEM相比,MemBodied的对数较高,且耐久性和记忆足迹明显较低,平均成功率较高。 MemBodied还保留了一般的操控能力,在LIBERO上保持了类似的平均成功,同时改进了长视距套件. 这些结果共同支持了MemBodied作为扩展VLA控制观测历史的实用替代.

blocks.en: Vision-language-action models transfer semantic representations from pretrained vision-language models into robot control. blocks.en: Across these architectures, temporal context is limited to a bounded observation history or an action chunk. Such local context can preserve recently visible evidence, but it does not provide a persistent episodic state for information that must be retained beyond the input window or selectively carried across an episode.
blocks.zh: 在整个这些架构中,时间背景仅限于一个有界限的观测历史或一个动作块. 这种地方背景可以保存最近可见的证据,但不能为必须在输入窗口之外保留或有选择地在某一插曲间传递的信息提供持续的零星状态。

blocks.en: A.2 Memory representations for manipulation
blocks.zh: A.2 用于操纵的记忆表示

blocks.en: Recent memory-aware policies can be distinguished by the representation they preserve. Compressed-history methods retain selected observations as tokens. HAMLET Koo et al. (2026) encodes observations into moment tokens and aggregates them through a lightweight history module. NativeMEM Wang et al. (2026) reuses the VLA vision encoder to compress each historical camera frame into a native memory token. These methods preserve explicit temporal evidence more efficiently than raw frame histories, although their context can still grow with the number of retained observations.
blocks.zh: 近期的记忆意识政策可以通过它们保存的表述来区分. 压缩-历史方法保留了选定的观测作为符号. HAMLET Koo 等人 (美国) (2026)将观测编码为瞬间符号,并通过轻量级历史模块将其聚合. 本地母亲 王等编. (2026)重新使用VLA视觉编码器,将每个历史相机帧压缩成本土记忆符. 这些方法比原始框架历史更能有效地保存明确的时间证据,尽管随着保留的观测数量,其背景仍然可以增加。

blocks.en: Fixed-size recurrent methods compress history into a bounded latent state. μ \mu VLA carries learnable memory tokens across OpenVLA-OFT control steps and trains them with truncated backpropagation through time Cherepanov et al. (2026b) . ReMem-VLA propagates separate frame and chunk level recurrent queries Li et al. (2026) , while AVA-VLA uses recurrent state to modulate current visual features Xiao et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 固定大小的经常性方法将历史压缩成一个有界限的潜在状态. μ \mu VLA 携带可学习的内存符号跨越OpenVLA-OFT控制步骤,并用截断的反传播方式通过时间Cherepanov et al. (2026b)进行训练. ReMem-VLA传播了独立的帧和块级的经常性查询Li等人(2026年),而AVA-VLA则使用经常性状态来调节当前视觉特征Xiao等人(2026年).

blocks.en: Memory-bank and retrieval methods provide more structured storage. SAM2Act Fang et al. (2025) integrates a visual memory architecture for manipulation, and MemoryVLA combines working-memory tokens with a bank that preserves visual detail and higher-level semantics Shi et al. (2026) . MAP-VLA Li et al. (2025) retrieves task-stage prompts learned from demonstrations. Notes-to-Self Haresh et al. (2026) externalises object locations, plans, and subgoal progress in a language scratchpad. These systems make memory content more explicit, but they introduce a bank, retrieval rule, or language-generation channel in addition to the recurrent policy state.
blocks.zh: 存储库和检索方法提供了更结构化的存储. SAM2 Act Fang 等 (英语). (2025年)整合了用于操纵的视觉内存架构,MuseumVLA将工作-记忆符号与保存视觉细节和更高层次语义的银行(2026年)结合. MAP-VLA Li 等人(2025年)检索了从示威中吸取的阶段任务提示. Haresh等人(2026年)对目标位置、计划和次级目标进行外部化,在语言抓字板上取得进展。 这些系统使得内存内容更加明确,但它们除了经常性的政策状态外,还引入了银行,检索规则,或语言生成通道.

blocks.en: MemBodied occupies a different position in this design space. It neither retains a growing sequence of observations nor retrieves discrete memory entries. Instead, it represents episode history through a set of layer-wise associative matrices and an initial-scene anchor, both with storage independent of episode length, and conditions the action expert on their readouts.
blocks.zh: MemBodied在这个设计空间中占据了不同的地位. 它既不保留不断增长的观察序列,也不检索离散的内存条目. 相反,它通过一组分层的关联矩阵和一个初始场景主播代表了剧集历史,既具有独立于剧集长度的存储功能,又为动作专家的朗读提供了条件.

blocks.en: A.3 Fast-weight associative memory
blocks.zh: A.3 快速重联记忆

blocks.en: Fast-weight models separate slowly optimised parameters from rapidly updated episode state. Schmidhuber (1992) introduced learned control of fast-weight memories. Linear attention was later interpreted as an associative fast-weight programmer Schlag et al. (2021) . DeltaNet replaced purely additive key-value writes with a delta rule that corrects the association already recalled for a key, and Gated DeltaNet added data-dependent retention Yang et al. (2025) . Most directly related, δ \delta -mem augments a language model with a fixed-size online matrix whose readout produces low-rank attention corrections Lei et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 快重模型将缓慢优化的参数与快速更新的插曲状态分开. Schmidhuber(1992年)引入了对快重记忆的学习控制. 线性注意力后来被解读为联合快重程序员Schlag等人(2021年). 德尔塔 Gated DeltaNet增加了依赖数据的杨等人(2025年)。 最直接相关的是 \\ delta - mem 用固定大小的在线矩阵来增强语言模型, 其读取产生低级的注意力校正 Lei等人(2026年).

blocks.en: MemBodied transfers the associative-state principle to continuous robot control. Rather than perturbing attention queries or outputs, it injects a projected memory vector into a dedicated suffix token before attention. We use this interface comparison to analyse how an associative state is most effectively exposed to the action network.
blocks.zh: MemBodied将关联态原理转移给连续机器人控制. 它不是扰动注意查询或输出,而是在注意前将预测的内存矢量注入一个专用的后缀符号. 我们利用这个接口比较来分析一个关联状态如何最有效地暴露在行动网络中.

blocks.en: A.4 Memory-focused evaluation
blocks.zh: A.4 注重记忆的评价

blocks.en: Memory-specific manipulation benchmarks have recently proliferated. MemoryBench evaluates spatial memory and action recall, requiring policies to recover scene information or actions from earlier in an episode Fang et al. (2025) . MIKASA-Robo broadens this scope through a diverse set of partially observable tabletop tasks designed to test memory-intensive control Cherepanov et al. (2026a) . RMBench comprises nine dual-arm manipulation tasks organised by memory complexity, ranging from retaining information from a single earlier stage to accumulating evidence across multiple observations or attempts Chen et al. (2026) . We use RMBench as our primary memory evaluation benchmark because its controlled M ⁡ ( 1 ) M(1) and M ⁡ ( n ) M(n) categories distinguish tasks that require retaining a single earlier event from those that require accumulating information across several events within a common bimanual manipulation setting. In contrast, LIBERO is not designed specifically around episodic recall; its spatial, object, goal, and long-horizon suites provide a complementary test of whether a memory-augmented policy remains effective on general manipulation Liu et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 最近,针对记忆的操纵基准激增。 Memory Bench评价空间记忆和动作召回,要求政策从早先的一集Fang等人(2025年)中恢复场景信息或动作. MIKASA-Robo通过一套多样的可部分观测到的台式工作来拓宽这一范围,这些任务旨在测试内存密集控制Cherepanov等人(2026a). 人民币由9项双臂操纵任务组成,任务由内存复杂度所组织,从保留一个较早阶段的信息到通过多重观察或尝试积累证据不等 陈等 (2026). 我们使用人民币作为我们的首要内存评价基准,因为其控制的MQ(1) M(1)和MQ(n) M(n)类别区分了需要保留一个较早的事件的任务和需要在共同的双人操纵环境下积累若干事件的信息的任务。 相比之下,LIBERO并不是专门围绕偶发性召回设计的;它的空间,对象,目标,以及长视的套房提供了辅助性测试,以检验一项记忆强化政策在一般操控刘等人(2023年)上是否依然有效.

blocks.en: We trained the LIBERO experiment differently from the RMBench models using full fine-tuning to match the published π 0 \pi_{0} baseline setup. Training used a batch size of 32, 30,000 steps, and a sequence length of six. Evaluation used five-step replanning, following the official π 0 \pi_{0} LIBERO setup. To match this replanning cadence while retaining the 50-step memory-update interval used during training, we maintained ten recurrent memory slots in a round-robin schedule. Each five-step policy call reads one slot, and that slot was revisited after 50 environment steps. At the revisit, the delayed write used the new observation together with a summary of the complete 50-step action chunk predicted on the slot’s previous visit. This summary therefore includes predicted actions beyond the five steps executed before the next replan.

blocks.en: The internal variants changed how the associative state affected action generation. MemBodied -AS projected each retrieval into additive corrections to the attention query and output representations. MemBodied -H augmented the gated-delta state with a slower LSTM-like recurrent cell controlled by a learned forget gate. The latter therefore changed the state dynamics as well as its use by the action network, so these results compare complete memory designs rather than isolated readout substitutions.
blocks.zh: 内部变体改变了关联状态如何影响动作生成. MemBodied -AS将每次检索都投射到注意力查询和输出说明的添加修正中。 MemBodied -H 增加了门-德尔塔状态,以一个学习的忘却门控制的LSTM型复发细胞. 后者因此改变了状态动态以及动作网络的使用,因此这些结果比较了完整的内存设计,而不是孤立的读出替代.

blocks.en: Unlike the other locally trained RMBench baselines, the NativeMEM baseline followed a separate staged training procedure. A memory tokenizer was first trained on the RMBench mixture for 50,000 steps, after which its per-frame, per-view tokens were cached offline for each target task. The tokenizer was then frozen while the queue-conditioned policy was trained for 20,000 steps. The standalone model used a queue stride of one; the combined NativeMEM + MemBodied model retained this queue while training the associative state with sequence length 8 and stride 50.
blocks.zh: 与其他当地培训的人民币基准不同的是,土著MEM基线采用了单独的分阶段培训程序。 首次对内存指示器进行了人民币混合5万步的培训,之后其每帧,每景指示器被缓存到下线,用于每项目标任务. 标语器随后被冷冻,同时排队条件的政策被训练了2万步. 独立模型使用了一个队列的步态;合并的IndimalMEM + MemBodied模型保留了这个队列,同时以序列长度8和步态50来训练关联状态.

blocks.en: At each action-expert layer, the state token queries the associative matrix. Separate learned projections turn the readout into additive corrections to the action tokens’ attention queries and projected attention outputs. blocks.en: B.6 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} adaptation
blocks.zh: 适应

blocks.en: Unlike π 0 \pi_{0} , π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} represents robot state in the language prefix and has no dedicated state token in the action-expert suffix. We therefore use the memory token’s hidden representation for both associative-memory operations. At each action-expert layer, the token’s pre-attention representation is projected to form the read query, and the gated retrieval is then added to that token before attention. Its post-layer representation is projected to form the write key for the subsequent memory update, whose value combines the action summary with the following visual observation. The token is recreated on each call, whereas the associative matrices persist across calls within an episode. The initial-scene anchor is retained by fusing its readout into the action tokens.
blocks.zh: 与^0\pi_{0}不同的是,^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}在语言前缀中代表机器人状态,在动作专家后缀中没有专用的状态标志. 因此,我们使用记忆符的隐藏代表进行联合-模拟行动。 在每一行动专家层面,信使的预留表示预计将形成读取的查询,然后在注意之前将门状检索加入该信使中。 它的后层表现预计会形成后续内存更新的书写密钥,其价值将动作摘要与以下视觉观察结合起来. 每次通话时都会重现代币,而关联矩阵则在一集内贯穿各场通话. 初始-场景主锚通过将其读取器安装到动作符中而保留.

blocks.en: B.7 Inference-efficiency profiling
blocks.zh: B.7 推断效率分析

blocks.en: We profiled MemBodied and NativeMEM in bfloat16 on NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 80 GB of VRAM, using one GPU per evaluation run. We measured model-side computation only. For MemBodied , timing covered policy calls from invocation until the action array was returned. This includes policy-side input preprocessing, current-observation vision encoding, associative-memory reads and updates, and generation of a 50-step action chunk using 10 flow-matching denoising steps. For NativeMEM, per-cycle latency was the sum of the model-side time for all video history encoding calls since the preceding policy query and the subsequent policy inference call. This includes per-frame video-history encoding, updates to the expanding history queue and policy context, and action generation.
blocks.zh: 我们在NVIDIA A100 GPU的bfloat16上将MemBodied和IndigendMEM进行了配置,其中80GB为VRAM,每次评估运行使用一个GPU. 我们只测量了模型侧计算。 对MemBodied来说,时间包括从援引到返回行动阵列的政策呼吁。 这包括政策侧输入预处理、当前观测视觉编码、关联-模拟读物和更新,以及利用10个流比去诺步骤生成一个50步动作块。 对NeignMEM来说,每轮延迟是自前一次政策查询和随后的政策推断调用以来所有视频历史编码调用的模式-侧时间的总和. 这包括按帧录影史编码、更新不断扩大的历史队列和政策背景以及行动生成。

blocks.en: We evaluated Put Back Block, Rearrange Blocks, Swap Blocks, and Battery Try for 50 episodes per task and policy, yielding 200 episodes per policy. The first three policy queries of each task-policy run were treated as warm-up and excluded. The reported steady-state latency is the arithmetic mean over all retained policy cycles pooled across the four tasks, comprising 2,548 NativeMEM cycles and 2,563 MemBodied cycles. Peak memory is the maximum JAX allocator peak_bytes_in_use observed across all calls and tasks. NativeMEM required 1,593.7 ms per policy cycle and 20.57 GiB of peak GPU memory, whereas MemBodied required 129.2 ms and 18.61 GiB, corresponding to 91.9% lower latency and 9.5% lower peak memory.

blocks.en: Demonstrations affected by recording faults were removed before training. The retained trajectories were temporally trimmed to the demonstrated interaction, and the recorded joint states were denoised. The top-camera stream was cropped to the task workspace during preprocessing. blocks.en: We evaluated each policy for 20 physical rollouts on each task. blocks.en: In the anchor-free memory-token variant, success increases monotonically as the rank grows from 32 to 64 to 128 on both Put Back Block and Rearrange Blocks (Figure 6 ). Their two-task mean rises from 27.0% to 42.0% and 55.0%, respectively. The policy’s sensitivity to rank is consistent with associative-state capacity influencing action selection: a larger state can preserve a richer set of episode-dependent associations for later retrieval.
blocks.zh: 在无锚内存-托肯变体中,成功单调增加,因为Put Back Block和Rearrange Blocks上的排名都从32位增长到64位到128位(图6 ). 他们的双重任务分别从27.0%上升到42.0%和55.0%。 政策对排名的敏感性与关联国影响行动选择的能力是一致的:一个较大的国家可以保留更丰富的一系列依赖插曲的关联,供日后检索.

blocks.en: We also tested a simpler way to provide the initial scene: adding the episode’s first frame to the policy prefix alongside the current input, rather than using the fixed episode-anchor pathway. On Put Back Block task, this first-frame-prefix variant achieved 22.0% success, compared with 34.0% for the memory-token model without an anchor and 40.0% with the proposed anchor. This could be because adding the full first frame introduces distracting visual tokens into the policy context, whereas the anchor selectively retrieves a compact reference to the initial scene.
blocks.zh: 我们还测试了一种提供初始场景的更简单的方法:在政策前缀中加入该集的第一个帧,同时加入当前输入,而不是使用固定的插曲-锁定路径. Put Back Block任务上,这个首帧前缀变体获得了22.0%的成功率,而没有主锚的内存磁盘模型则取得了34.0%的成功率,与拟议的主锚相比则取得了40.0%的成功率. 这可能是因为加上完整的第一帧会将视觉符号引向政策背景,而主播则有选择地检索到对初始场景的紧凑的参考.

blocks.en: D.4 Cross-Episode Memory Carryover
blocks.zh: D.4 跨集记忆结转

blocks.en: As an exploratory test, we carry the associative state across rollout boundaries, although MemBodied was trained with the state reset at the start of each episode. The initial-frame anchor is still reset for each new rollout. Table 6 shows that this reduces mean success from 50.0% to 36.8%, with lower success on four of the five tasks. The largest declines occur on Put Back Block and Swap Blocks (22 and 20 percentage points), where the relevant location or progress must be established within the current episode. Block Ranking is the exception, improving by 6 points. Its trial-and-error structure may respond differently to carried state, although this increase does not establish that information from earlier episodes was useful. Overall, the results do not support a general benefit from carrying over memory under this evaluation, as the declines are consistent with information from earlier episodes interfering with episode-specific decisions.

Across both groups, the policies behave similarly when the current observation is sufficient, but diverge once the correct action depends on information that is no longer visible.

blocks.en: E.1.1 Put Back Block
blocks.zh: E.1.1 退后块

blocks.en: Put Back Block isolates spatial recall: both policies move the block to the centre and press the button in every rollout, but they differ when deciding where to return it. The stateless policy returns to the wrong pad in 37/50 rollouts. Its 13 correct choices are close to the 13.8 expected from its own pad preference, indicating that its return location does not track the episode’s initial pad. MemBodied reduces wrong-pad returns to 13/50 and corrects 24 stateless errors without introducing the reverse error on any paired seed. Its 37 correct choices also exceed the 14.5 expected by chance. Both comparisons are significant at p < 10 − 4 p{<}10^{-4} . The benefit of MemBodied is therefore concentrated on the history-dependent choice of return location, rather than the preceding pick-and-place sequence.
blocks.zh: Put Back Block 隔离空间召回: 两种政策都将块移动到中心,并在每次推出时按下按钮,但在决定返回地点时却有所不同. 无国籍政策在37/50推出时又回到了错误的位置。 它的13个正确的选择接近它自己的垫料偏好预期的13.8,表明它的返回位置没有跟踪该集的最初垫料. MemBodied将错误的粘贴返回减少到13/50,并纠正了24个无国籍错误,而没有在任何对子种子上引入反差. 它的37项正确选择也超过了偶然预期的14.5项. 这两种比较在p < 10 - 4 p - 10 - 4} 中都是重要的。 因此,MemBodied的好处集中在历史所决定的返回地点,而不是之前的选址顺序。

blocks.en: Aside from the recall errors, the remaining failures expose two execution constraints. Of the 17 correct returns towards the front pad, 14 reach the pad but stall instead of releasing the block. The stateless policy exhibits the same tendency in 8/9 relevant rollouts, suggesting a shared placement difficulty rather than a memory-specific failure. In addition, six of MemBodied ’s eight failures classified as residual recall errors occur when the block starts on the right: the policy repeats its dominant left-arm motion towards the front pad instead of switching arms. These two patterns account for 20 of the 30 MemBodied failures. Thus, memory largely resolves the target location recall problem, but not the motor strategy needed to reach every target reliably.
blocks.zh: 除了召回错误外,其余的失败暴露出两个执行限制. 在往前台的17个正确返回中,有14个到达了前台,但却拖延了下来,而不是释放出块. 无国籍政策在8/9相关推出时也显示出同样的趋势,表明存在共同的安置困难,而不是记忆方面的故障。 此外,MemBodied的8次失误中,有6次被归类为剩余召回错误,发生于块从右边开始:政策重复其主要左臂运动向前台,而不是转动武器。 这两个模式占了30个MemBodied失败中的20个. 因此,记忆在很大程度上解决了目标地点召回问题,但不是可靠地达到每个目标所需的机动战略。

blocks.en: E.1.2 Rearrange Blocks
blocks.zh: 经济及社会理事会 重新排列块

blocks.en: Rearrange Blocks tests recall through object selection rather than target selection. After the first placement and button press, both mats contain identical blocks, so only the initial layout identifies which block should be returned to the gap. Both policies complete the shared early stages in every rollout, but their subsequent choices differ. MemBodied selects the correct block specified by the initial layout in all 50 rollouts. The stateless policy instead exhibits a strong left-block preference: it chooses the left block in 37/40 rollouts in which it moves a block, selects the correct block only 20 times, and moves no block in the remaining ten rollouts. This shows that memory changes the episode-specific decision made after the two scenes become visually indistinguishable, rather than merely improving the manipulation stages.
blocks.zh: 重新排列块测试通过对象选择而不是目标选择召回. 在第一次放置和按键后,两个垫都包含相同的块,因此只有初始布局识别出哪个块应该返回到空隙. 这两项政策在每次推出时都完成了共同的早期阶段,但其随后的选择各不相同。 MemBodied在所有50个展开中选择由初始布局指定的正确块. 无国籍政策却表现出强烈的左块偏好:在37/40的推出中选择左块,其中移动一个块,只选择正确块20次,其余10个推出中不移动块. 这表明记忆改变了两个场景变得视而不见后作出的针对具体剧集的决定,而不仅仅是改进操纵阶段.

blocks.en: Object selection does not explain the entire performance gap. Of the 20 stateless rollouts that select the correct block and bring it to the target pad, only one succeeds, whereas MemBodied succeeds in 46/50 rollouts overall. The stateless policy also does not press the button fully, leading to task failures. These execution errors occur after the history-dependent object selection and therefore compound, rather than explain, the recall gap.
blocks.zh: 对象选择不能解释整个性能差距. 在20个选择正确块并将其带入目标垫的无国籍者推出中,只有一个成功,而MemBodied则在总体上成功推出46/50。 无国籍政策也没有完全按下按钮,导致任务失败. 这些执行错误发生在依赖历史的对象选择之后,因此增加了而不是解释召回漏洞.

blocks.en: E.1.3 Swap Blocks
blocks.zh: E.1.3 交换区块

blocks.en: Swap Blocks differs from the previous tasks because the hidden variable is progress rather than an initial location. Exchanging two identical blocks requires three moves through an empty pad, after which the visible occupancy matches the start of the episode. Intermediate occupancy patterns can also be valid starting layouts. Consequently, the current image does not reveal whether the policy should move another block or press the completion button.
blocks.zh: 交换块与之前的任务不同,因为隐藏的变量是进步而不是初始位置. 交换两个相同的块需要通过一个空的垫板进行三次移动,之后可见的占用与剧集的开始吻合. 中间占用模式也可以是有效的起始布局. 因此,当前图像没有显示策略是应该移动另一个块还是应该按完成按钮.

blocks.en: Both policies can perform the required manipulation: MemBodied makes at least one move in 48/50 rollouts and the stateless policy in 41/50. The main difference is in deciding when the swap is complete. The stateless policy presses the completion button prematurely in 41/50 rollouts, compared with 19/50 for MemBodied , and completes all three moves in only eight rollouts, compared to 31 for MemBodied . Among rollouts in which the button is pressed, MemBodied waits until the swap is complete in 28/47 cases, whereas the stateless policy does so in only 6/47. All three progress-related comparisons remain significant ( p < 10 − 4 p{<}10^{-4} ). This pattern is consistent with memory tracking progress through the move sequence. However, the tracking is not perfect: 12 of the 22 residual MemBodied failures press after two moves, making the final transition the dominant remaining error.
blocks.zh: 这两项政策都可以按规定进行操纵: MemBodied在48/50推出时至少做了一项行动,在41/50推出无国籍政策。 主要区别在于决定交换何时完成. 与MemBodied的19/50相比, 在按下按钮的推出中,MemBodied在28/47案件中等待交换完成,而无国籍政策只在6/47案件中这样做。 所有三项与进展有关的比较仍然重要(p < 10 - 4 p{<}10^{-4})。 这种模式与通过移动序列跟踪内存进度一致. 然而,跟踪并不完美:22个剩余MemBodied故障中,有12个在两步后按下,使得最终的过渡成为占优势的剩余错误.

blocks.en: E.2 Accumulating outcomes across attempts
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 各种尝试的累积结果

blocks.en: E.2.1 Battery Try
blocks.zh: E.2.1 电池试验

blocks.en:
Battery Try requires the policy to change its next action after transient failure feedback. The two policies set both batteries at similar rates (23/50 for MemBodied and 20/50 for π 0 \pi_{0} -Stateless), indicating comparable
grasp-and-insert behaviour before memory is needed. They diverge after an unsuccessful orientation test, once the meter has returned to rest and the current image no longer reveals what was tried. The stateless policy makes a median of four further attempts and completes the task in 8/20 rollouts; MemBodied usually succeeds within one further attempt and resolves it in 20/23. This difference remains significant after Holm correction ( p = 0.028 p{=}0.028 ), localising the benefit of MemBodied to the point where an earlier outcome must alter the next action. The dominant remaining limitation is grasp stability: 25 of the 30 MemBodied failures involve dropping a battery during pickup or insertion, a common failure mode in both policies.

电池 尝试要求策略在瞬间失败反馈后更改其下一个动作. 这两项政策都规定两个电池的电速相同(MemBodied为23/50,而0\pi_{0}-无状态),表明具有可比性。
在需要记忆之前,掌握和插入行为。 他们经过一次不成功的定向测试后,一旦计数器恢复了休止,而目前的形象也不再揭示所尝试的。 无国籍政策使四次尝试达到中位数,并在8/20的推出中完成这项任务; MemBodied通常在一次尝试中取得成功,并在20/23年解决。 在Holm修正(p = 0.028 p = 0.028)之后,这一差异仍然很大,将MemBodied的惠益定位到一个更早的结果必须改变下一个行动的程度。 其余的主要限制是把握稳定性:在30个MemBodied故障中,有25个涉及在接车或插入时投放电池,这是两种政策中常见的故障模式。

blocks.en: E.2.2 Block Ranking Try
blocks.zh: E.2.2 区块排名 尝试

blocks.en: Block Ranking Try extends the same dependence on earlier outcomes to a longer search. Both policies complete an initial block arrangement at similar rates (38/50 for MemBodied and 40/50 for π 0 \pi_{0} -Stateless), but differ in whether they verify it. MemBodied presses the test button after 35/38 completed arrangements, compared with 14/40 for the stateless policy. On four paired seeds, the stateless policy even constructs the same arrangement that MemBodied successfully verifies but dismantles it without testing it. Because a completed arrangement looks identical before and after testing, this difference shows that MemBodied helps in remembering whether a candidate arrangement still needs to be verified, rather than in the preceding pick-and-place operation.
blocks.zh: 块排名 尝试将同样的对先前结果的依赖扩展为更长的搜索. 两项政策都以相似的速度完成了初步的块状安排(MemBodied为38/50, π0\pi_{0}-无国号),但是在是否核实上有所不同. MemBodied在完成35/38安排后按下测试按钮,而无国籍政策则按14/40。 在四对种子上,无国籍政策甚至构建了与MemBodied成功验证相同的安排,但在未测试的情况下将其拆除。 由于一个完成的安排在测试前后看起来完全相同,这种差异表明,MemBodied有助于记住一个候选安排是否需要核实,而不是在之前的选址操作中.

blocks.en: The remaining errors separate immediate verification from longer-term search. Six of the 14 stateless button presses miss the button, compared with none of the 35 MemBodied presses, so motor precision further compounds the stateless failure rate. After a rejected arrangement, however, MemBodied builds and tests a new order in only 10/28 rollouts; in other cases, it fails in rearranging the blocks or retests the rejected arrangement. These longer-search errors do not differ from the stateless policy. The differences in immediate verification and button execution both remain significant after Holm correction ( p ≤ 0.001 p{\leq}0.001 ), but the broader pattern shows that memory supports the immediate transition from rearranging to verification more clearly than the full multi-attempt search.
blocks.zh: 其余的错误将立即核查与长期搜索分开。 14个无国籍按钮中,有6个按错按钮,而35个MemBodied按键中,没有1个按错,因此运动精度进一步加重了无国籍故障率. 然而,在一项被拒绝的安排之后,MemBodied只在10/28推出时建造并测试了新的订单;在其他情况下,它未能重新安排区块或重新测试被拒绝的安排。 这些较长的搜索错误与无国籍政策并无不同. 在Holm更正后(p 0.001 p{\leq}0.001),即时核查和按键执行方面的差异仍然很大,但更广泛的模式表明,内存支持从重新安排到核查的即时过渡,比全面多试搜索更明确.

blocks.en: Across all five tasks, the rollout analysis localises the performance gains shown in Section 5 to the decisions that require past information in an episode. MemBodied does not consistently change the early motor stages shared by both policies. Instead, it reduces the failure specific to each aliased decision: returning to the wrong pad, selecting the wrong block, declaring a swap complete too early, repeating an unsuccessful battery orientation, or dismantling an arrangement before testing it. The remaining failures separate into execution errors, such as stalling, missed presses, and dropped objects, and longer-term memory errors that arise when several updates must be retained. These behavioural patterns are consistent with the recurrent state retaining task-relevant episode information while preserving general robot control ability.
blocks.zh: 在所有五项任务中,推出分析将第5节显示的绩效收益与某一集需要过去资料的决定联系起来。 MemBodied没有始终如一地改变两种政策共有的早期运动阶段。 相反,它减少了每个别名决定特有的故障:返回错误的垫,选择错误的块,宣布一个互换提前完成,重复一个不成功的电池导向,或者在测试之前拆除一个安排. 其余的失败被分离成执行错误,如延时,错失了按数,并丢弃了对象,以及一些必须保留更新时产生的长期内存错误. 这些行为模式与经常性状态保留与任务相关的插曲信息是一致的,同时保留了一般的机器人控制能力.
